event.odalys_heart2.0.text: Sit. No, stand. Hold still, [player]. You walked in without a single complaint, which is suspicious in itself.
event.odalys_heart2.0.why: greeting tic undercut; she is checking the player, not scolding

event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Strong and steady. All that digging is good for something besides the turnips.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: keeps the compliment, lands on a farm word

event.odalys_heart2.2.text: Two salads. Eat them sitting down, at a table, in daylight. Doctor's orders.
event.odalys_heart2.2.why: matches the item given; the prescription bit with the catchphrase

event.odalys_heart5.0.text: Sit. This is my notebook of remedies. Every cure that ever worked in Wetherell, and several that only worked on Marcus.
event.odalys_heart5.0.why: specific object, gentle jab at her obedient patient

event.odalys_heart5.1.text: I copied one out for you. The forager's plate: hedge greens, mushrooms, a little salt, eaten outdoors.

event.odalys_heart5.2.text: Use it well. If it works, write it in the margin. I like to know what helps.
event.odalys_heart5.2.why: invites the player into her record; her want to help

dlg.story.pie.talk.r0b.text: A stranger with excellent taste and sawdust on the note. ...It's rather good. Tell him nothing.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r0b.why: she sees through the anonymity and keeps the feud alive

dlg.story.pie.talk.r1b.text: Someone added cinnamon. It's better now. I resent that, professionally.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r1b.why: deadpan embarrassment, sets up Marcus's 'Cheek' note

dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.text: An empty plate and a crumb on your sleeve. I'll bill Marcus for one pie. You, for the crumb.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.why: teases the situation, ends on the funniest word

event.odalys_heart8.intro.text: Sit. I closed the clinic early today. I'm taking my own prescription: soup, and company. I've been short of both.
event.odalys_heart8.intro.why: fixes the 'tonight' clash with a 9-17 trigger; admits loneliness sideways

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I tell everyone to rest. I have never once done it on a weekday. This is unfamiliar. Be gentle.

dlg.odalys.office.1.text: So, [player]. Your professional opinion? I'll be taking notes.

dlg.odalys.office.c1.text: Pull up a chair and share the soup.

dlg.odalys.office.c2.text: Write her a prescription of your own.
dlg.odalys.office.c2.why: playful, turns her bit on her

dlg.odalys.office.r0.text: You insist. ...Very well. Under protest, with soup, and in front of a witness.

dlg.odalys.office.r1.text: Two spoons, one pot. That's the entire treatment. You diagnosed me faster than I would have.

dlg.odalys.office.r2.text: A prescription. For me. 'Come back anyway.' ...I've never been given orders I wanted to follow.
dlg.odalys.office.r2.why: the gift lands as feeling, not quip

event.odalys_heart8.after.text: {if choice:office.insist}You insisted I rest. I filed it under 'Unreasonable'. Then I slept nine hours. Elara is unbearable about it.{else}{if choice:office.soup}We finished the pot. I've written it up: 'Treatment successful. Repeat weekly.' That last part was not a question.{else}Your prescription is pinned above my desk. 'Come back anyway.' I intend to comply. Doctor's orders.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_heart8.after.why: each branch shows the choice took, and each asks for more

event.odalys_birthday.intro.text: Sit. It's my birthday. I observe it with soup. That is an invitation, not an order. Mostly.

dlg.odalys.birthday.c0.why: unchanged meaning; kept plain and warm

dlg.odalys.birthday.c1.text: Pull up a chair for the soup.

dlg.odalys.birthday.r0.text: ...Thank you. Most people wish me well by not needing me today. This is better.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r0.why: subtext: she is rarely celebrated, only consulted

dlg.odalys.birthday.r1.text: Then pass your bowl. Leek and potato, and an irresponsible amount of pepper. It's my birthday.

dlg.odalys.birthday.r2.text: A nap, prescribed by a farmer. ...I'll comply. My patients will be told it was an emergency.

event.odalys_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.odalys.wish}It went in the file labeled 'Unexpected'. That file was empty last winter. It isn't now.{else}{if choice:bday.odalys.soup}Shared soup. Elara made me write 'Successful' in red ink. She brought the ink.{else}I napped twenty minutes. The clinic survived. Elara says nothing happened. She said it very quickly.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_birthday.after.why: each branch callbacks the choice and leaves a small question

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l2.text: Elara. The stool is wearing a cozy. ...It suits it. Leave it on.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l4.text: No. One cozy per stool. That is clinic policy, as of now.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l4.why: the frown that is really a smile

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l2.text: Elara. I accept the soup. I need to know the surprise first. Professionally.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l4.text: ...It's the best soup I've had all year. Save me a bowl. Don't tell the turnip.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l4.why: warmth, then plays along with Elara's joke

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.text: Elara. It's very soft. ...Ten minutes after lunch. Do not mistake that for a habit.

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.text: That was good care, Elara. Wake me for emergencies only. Splinters are not emergencies.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l4.why: warm first, joke at Marcus's expense second

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.text: Ione. Your lamps were still lit an hour past closing.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l1.why: specific observation, concern disguised as report

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.text: Patients keep odd hours. Books do not. ...Very well. Call it a draw.

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l1.text: Ione. I prescribe you a nap. Ten minutes. I've already written it down.

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l3.text: ...Chapter one, then the nap. I'll return the book by hand. Your returns box is sticky again.

adds.text: When did you last eat sitting down? Bread over a seed bag does not count.
adds.why: she checks whether the player looks after themselves

adds.text: Marcus is the only patient who comes when I call. I'm working on the rest of the village.
adds.why: ends on her want, a village that rests

adds.text: Edmund has a page in here too. He followed every instruction. The same way he put his affairs in order.
adds.why: her sanctioned Edmund thread, said with respect, not explained

threads.odalys_heart2: Who else in the village is avoiding Dr. Penn's checkups?
threads.odalys_heart5: What did Edmund's page in the remedy notebook say?
threads.odalys_heart8: Will the doctor really keep resting, and with whom?

threads.overheard_elara_odalys_3: Does Dr. Penn actually take the ten-minute nap?

notes: odalys_heart8: the trigger is hour 9-17 but the old intro said 'tonight'; I changed it to 'closed the clinic early today'. The bible's 'rare quiet evening' would need the trigger moved to evening.
odalys_heart2: the old line called the gift 'a tonic' but the effect gives two salads; the line now names salads.
